def_en: To take a computer apart, piece by piece.
example_en: First, disassemble the computer carefully.
example_es: Primero, desmonta el ordenador con cuidado.

def_en: To put the parts of a computer together.
example_en: Assemble the parts in the right order.
example_es: Monta las piezas en el orden correcto.

def_en: To turn off the computer properly through the software before physical work.
example_en: Shut down the computer before opening the case.
example_es: Apaga el ordenador antes de abrir la caja.

def_en: To remove a cable from a port or socket.
example_en: Unplug the power cable from the socket.
example_es: Desenchufa el cable de alimentación de la toma.

def_en: To insert a cable into a port or socket.
example_en: Plug in the keyboard to the USB port.
example_es: Conecta el teclado al puerto USB.

def_en: To remove a screw with a screwdriver.
example_en: Unscrew the four screws on the back panel.
example_es: Desatornilla los cuatro tornillos del panel trasero.

def_en: To fix a part with a screw.
example_en: Screw the hard drive to the case.
example_es: Atornilla el disco duro a la caja.

def_en: To move a part smoothly out of its place.
example_en: Slide out the side panel of the tower.
example_es: Saca deslizando el panel lateral de la torre.

def_en: To move a part smoothly into its place.
example_en: Slide the power supply into its slot.
example_es: Introduce deslizando la fuente de alimentación en su ranura.

def_en: To line up a part with the holes or the slot.
example_en: Align the memory module with the slot.
example_es: Alinea el módulo de memoria con la ranura.

def_en: To carefully lift a part out of the case.
example_en: Lift out the motherboard carefully.
example_es: Levanta y saca la placa base con cuidado.

def_en: To remove a part by pulling it.
example_en: Pull out the old graphics card gently.
example_es: Extrae con suavidad la tarjeta gráfica antigua.

def_en: To lock into the correct position with a click.
example_en: Press until the module snaps into place.
example_es: Presiona hasta que el módulo encaje con un clic.

def_en: To verify that all parts and cables are connected correctly.
example_en: Double check all the cables before you power on.
example_es: Comprueba dos veces todos los cables antes de encender.

def_en: To turn on the computer after the assembly is complete.
example_en: Power on the computer and wait for the logo.
example_es: Enciende el ordenador y espera al logotipo.

def_en: To choose an option in a menu, for example in the BIOS.
example_en: Select the USB drive in the boot menu.
example_es: Selecciona la unidad USB en el menú de arranque.

def_en: To return to the previous menu.
example_en: Press Esc to go back.
example_es: Pulsa Esc para volver atrás.

def_en: To make a screw or a cable more firm.
example_en: Tighten the screws, but do not use too much force.
example_es: Aprieta los tornillos, pero sin usar demasiada fuerza.

def_en: To make a screw less tight.
example_en: Loosen the screw and remove the cover.
example_es: Afloja el tornillo y quita la tapa.

def_en: To put a part inside another part.
example_en: Insert the memory module into the slot.
example_es: Inserta el módulo de memoria en la ranura.

def_en: To take something away from its place.
example_en: Remove the old battery.
example_es: Quita la batería vieja.

def_en: To put a new part in place of an old one.
example_en: Replace the faulty cable with a new one.
example_es: Sustituye el cable defectuoso por uno nuevo.

def_en: To join a device to another device or network.
example_en: Connect the printer to the network.
example_es: Conecta la impresora a la red.

def_en: To separate a device from another device or network.
example_en: Disconnect the laptop from the dock.
example_es: Desconecta el portátil de la base.

def_en: To turn a computer off and on again.
example_en: Please restart your computer and try again.
example_es: Por favor, reinicia tu ordenador e inténtalo otra vez.

def_en: To put a program on a computer so that it works.
example_en: Install the update on all the computers.
example_es: Instala la actualización en todos los ordenadores.

def_en: To remove a program from a computer.
example_en: Uninstall the old antivirus first.
example_es: Desinstala primero el antivirus antiguo.

def_en: To set up a device or a program so that it works correctly.
example_en: Configure the router before you connect the computers.
example_es: Configura el router antes de conectar los ordenadores.

def_en: To look for the cause of a problem and fix it.
example_en: I troubleshoot network problems every day.
example_es: Diagnostico y resuelvo problemas de red cada día.

def_en: To repair something that is broken.
example_en: He fixes computers for a living.
example_es: Arregla ordenadores para ganarse la vida.

def_en: To replace something with a better or newer version.
example_en: We upgrade the RAM to make the computer faster.
example_es: Ampliamos la RAM para que el ordenador sea más rápido.

def_en: To erase a disk and prepare it for new data.
example_en: Format the disk and install the system again.
example_es: Formatea el disco e instala el sistema otra vez.

def_en: To check a computer or a document for problems or viruses.
example_en: Scan the laptop for viruses.
example_es: Analiza el portátil en busca de virus.

def_en: To check whether something works correctly.
example_en: Test the cable with the diagnostic tool.
example_es: Prueba el cable con la herramienta de diagnóstico.

def_en: To enter your account with a username and password.
example_en: Log in with your username and password.
example_es: Inicia sesión con tu nombre de usuario y contraseña.

def_en: To leave your account.
example_en: Always log out when you leave your desk.
example_es: Cierra siempre la sesión cuando te vayas de tu mesa.

def_en: To make a copy of your files in case you lose them.
example_en: Back up your files every week.
example_es: Haz una copia de tus archivos cada semana.
